sourceVitestConfigDifferencesFromCapsule: Node24.19.0 and original installed Vitest4.1.11. Minimal node config omits DOM, aliases, host-port setup, feature-wall define, GC/WebStorage flags and extended timeout. No full original config equivalence claimed.
description: Complete unchanged static shell startup environment suite; filesystem calls mocked by original tests.
isolationRationale: Read complete original test and executable module. vi.mock replaces fs reads/listing/existence; process-local HOME/SHELL/XDG/platform substitutions are restored by original hooks. Only pure static parsing/path selection and cache execute; no actual shell launch, personal startup-file read, credentials or provider calls.
testEvidenceBoundary: Mocked static parsing and per-session source routing; simulated platforms are not native Windows or real shell precedence proof.
